plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I would have wanted five things the library does not offer. (1) An instrument that checks each case's category against the requester's rule, row by row. (2) An instrument that reads the live tables, rather than the staged set kept by its fingerprint, so I could confirm that the promoted state matches the staged set and that nothing else changed. (3) A check of which customers own the changed rows, matched to the approved list. (4) A check before sending that tells a preview call apart from a real send. A preview uses up the customer's one call under the release, and today only the trace at A3 shows it, after the fact. (5) A delivery check for the notices.
